newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Thursday 110,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Thursday 110,000 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said Thursday's est 110,000, Wk ago 98,000, Yr ago 105,000 head. Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts traded $1.00 higher than mid-session Wednesday. Trade was slow to moderate for moderate to good demand and light to moderate offerings. Top $54.00 per cwt.
US 1-3 46-49% Carcass Base Lean* Country Plants

*note - prices for 220-280 lbs represent hogs averaging 73-74 pct carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
